newsitem.title: USA: GM worker killed in engine plant shooting.
newsitem.headline: GM worker killed in engine plant shooting.

text.p: A General Motors Corp. worker shot and killed another employee outside an engine plant early Friday in what company officials called a personal dispute.

The shooting occurred about 5:50 a.m. EDT in a parking lot outside of the plant as employees were arriving for the start of the 6 a.m. shift, said Joseph Lawrence, a spokesman for GM's Powertrain Group.

"We know the person was reporting to work and the other person was waiting for him," said Lawrence, adding that both men knew each other. Flint police later apprehended the person who did the shooting, Lawrence said.
He would not release any names and referred other questions to Flint police, who could not be reached.
Production at the plant, which makes V-6 engines for a variety of GM cars, was not disrupted.
